personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines and proven methods, but approaches them with strong discipline and careful attention to detail. They usually plan ahead thoroughly and keep their environment organized, yet may become tense or overthink when plans change or problems feel uncertain. In moral dilemmas, they first look for clear rules or established standards, but if a principle feels important they will speak up firmly and defend their view. In group discussions, they are lively and talkative, contributing openly and confidently, though they may occasionally sound worried or overly concerned with possible risks.
